title: Istanbul vs Cairo: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Istanbul for comfort, food, and overall experience. Cairo for the Pyramids and ancient history depth. Both for the ultimate ancient-world route.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Turkish cuisine is deeper and more varied. Cairo has outstanding cheap street food but Istanbul wins overall.

categories.name: Historic Sites
categories.summary: Istanbul has Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi. Cairo has the Pyramids — a category-defining sight.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Cairo is cheaper overall, but Istanbul is exceptional value after the lira decline.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Istanbul has metro, tram, ferries on Istanbulkart. Cairo requires Uber + more planning.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Istanbul is very safe. Cairo is safe but has more touts and scams around tourist sites.

categories.name: Weather Window
categories.summary: Istanbul best Apr-Jun/Sep-Oct. Cairo best Oct-Apr. Never visit Cairo in summer.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Cairo wins — Luxor is one of the greatest day trips on earth. Istanbul has Ephesus and Cappadocia.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.summary: Istanbul is smoother, more accessible, less exhausting. Cairo is more challenging but unforgettable.

faq.question: Is Istanbul or Cairo better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Istanbul is the easier and more comfortable first-time experience.

faq.question: Which is cheaper: Istanbul or Cairo?
faq.answer: Cairo is cheaper but Istanbul offers exceptional value after the lira decline.

faq.question: Is Cairo safe for tourists?
faq.answer: Generally safe but requires more vigilance around tourist sites.
